qss.scope: Inherited F4 QSS encoder, all single-share erasures, and recycled entanglement
qss.physical_grouping: One ququart is two physical qubits; fixed alphabet independent of B,D
qss.limitations: Finite algebra check; no theorem, literature priority, or schedule certification

limitations: Symbolic schedule audit; QSS quantum identity is verified separately.
Finite tests support, and do not replace, the analytic induction.
Outputs may be released out of source order; extra in-order buffering is not simulated.

verified_invariants: Every actual and dummy source is recovered by its arrival+B deadline.
Every emitted packet has at most three source-sized shares.
Receiver retained quantum groups never exceed 2B, including returned dummy outputs.
Sender retained quantum groups never exceed 2B, including dummy reference halves.
For every N, the schedule ends after exactly N+2B slots with exactly B shared Bell groups.
Every initial seed and final dummy label is accounted for, including N<B.
Lost Q shares before source arrival are subsequently decoded from A,C.
limitations: Symbolic share/register bookkeeping, using the separately verified QSS identity.
Finite cases supplement the analytic proof and do not exhaust all admissible infinite streams.
Retained storage is measured after each slot; incoming packet workspace is charged separately.

scope: Finite coherent-algebra and symbolic schedule checks; universal claims use the written proofs.
